scripts.build: pnpm build:tokens && pnpm build:tailwind && vite build
scripts.build:fixtures: pnpm build && pnpm --filter neobrui-cube-css-modules build && pnpm --filter neobrui-cube-astro build && pnpm --filter neobrui-cube-tailwind build && node scripts/build-consumer-fixture.mjs
scripts.test: node --test tests/*.test.mjs && pnpm validate:tokens && pnpm test:e2e
scripts.capture:chromium: pnpm build:fixtures && CAPTURE_EVIDENCE=1 pnpm exec playwright test --project=chromium
scripts.build:docs: pnpm release:local && pnpm prepare:docs && pnpm exec astro build --root apps/docs
scripts.preview:docs: pnpm run build:docs && pnpm exec astro preview --root apps/docs
scripts.preview:docs:pages: pnpm run build:docs:pages && PUBLIC_SITE_BASE=/neobrui/ PUBLIC_SITE_URL=https://tekgadgt.github.io/neobrui/ pnpm exec astro preview --root apps/docs
